description: Mixes a polyphonic audio cable down to a stereo pair, with a level and a placing per channel

params.text: Attenuates the first level stage, 0 to 100%; with nothing patched to its input the knob alone sets that stage, and at 100% the audio passes through at full level
Attenuates the second level stage, 0 to 100%, and multiplies with the first; with nothing patched to its input the knob alone sets that stage
Sets the placing across the stereo field when nothing is patched to the pan input, hard left to hard right

inputs.text: Takes the polyphonic audio to be mixed down
Sets a level per channel, one channel per voice, where 10V is unity and the knob for it attenuates what arrives
Sets a second level per channel, where 10V is unity, multiplied with the first stage
Moves each channel across the stereo field, -5V to 5V added to the pan knob, one channel per voice

outputs.text: Carries the left side of the mix
Carries the right side of the mix

notes: with nothing patched to the right output the left output carries the whole mix rather than half of it
the pan is equal power, so the pair is louder at the centre than the sum of the two sides and nothing is scaled to hide it
